create.name: Nandhiji
create.bio:
Nandhiji, born Adhipen Bose in Sivakasi in Tamil Nadu, is a yogi and teacher in the Siddha tradition of South India who now lives and works in southern California. He grew up in a family known for its local industries, studied commerce in Chennai and business in London, and later left that career for years of austerity and meditation around Arunachala. He names eight gurus, among them forest-dwelling Siddhars, who guided him and asked him to carry their lineage.

His teaching, which he calls Mastery of Consciousness, uses mantra, breath, chakra meditation, sound and a yoga sequence of his own, Kalangi Kundalini, to help students reach the still awareness known in yoga as turiya and bring it into work and leadership. He offers recorded initiations, practice videos and chant albums, writes about the Siddha sages, and makes short films at South Indian temples explaining their stories and meaning. Since 2004 he has led World Yogi Day, a worldwide night of chanting and meditation at Mahashivaratri. He also founded the Declaration of Consciousness Movement and runs CNESS, a technology company built around conscious networking.

courses.title: SivaSivaa: Siddha guided chakra meditation with mantra initiation
courses.description: A recorded chakra meditation journey in which Nandhiji gives Siddha mantras and leads the practice step by step, with a twenty-page booklet explaining each mantra and technique. Sold as a digital download.

courses.title: Kalangi Kundalini Yoga: Yoga for the Achiever, Level One (Basics)
courses.description: Nandhiji's own daily yoga sequence for beginners and teachers alike, combining sun salutations with Siddha breathing and mantra. Available as a DVD or a digital download.

courses.title: Mastery of Consciousness: Awaken the Inner Prophet (ebook)
courses.description: Nandhiji's book in digital form: a short account of his life, 108 brief sutras on reaching turiya, essays on Siddha teaching, an interview and more than a hundred photographs from shrines in South India.

free_resources.title: Nandhiji on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Siddha mantra chants and recorded chanting sessions led by Nandhiji, including long Om and Shiva mantra recitations, free to listen to in the app or on the web.

sprint.tier_evidence: YouTube 3.78M (@nandhi108 header row, 1 Nov 2026); TikTok 378.3k (@nandhiji followerCount on public page, 1 Nov 2026); Instagram 227k (@nandhiji108 og:description, 1 Nov 2026); Insight Timer 970 (profile via WebFetch, 1 Nov 2026); Facebook, X and LinkedIn not readable without login → ~4.39M total → superhero
flags: Tier needs a human look: by the summed-followers rule he is a superhero (~4.39M, almost all YouTube), but his YouTube views are small for 3.78M subscribers (top videos 100k–234k views, most recent uploads a few hundred), which may point to promoted or bought growth; Insight Timer shows only 970 followers.
He is also founder and CEO of CNESS Inc., a social app and certification business promoted on his site; part of his YouTube output is CNESS or summit publicity (left out).
Most of his most-viewed videos are short (3–6 minute) temple films rather than teaching talks; kept as Siddha/temple lore, but a reviewer may prefer fewer.

His music pages claim the albums 'calibrate' above the enlightenment threshold on Hawkins's kinesiology scale and are 'ideal for body work & healing'; no music items are listed, but the site carries that language.
Email 123@nandhi.com from the site footer; the Santa Monica street address there may be a business (CNESS) office. Availability set to worldwide since no in-person classes are published.
His 'Mastery of Consciousness' Podia course page loads empty without JavaScript, so his paid online courses could not be verified.
left_out: Mastery of Consciousness book on Amazon: no amazon.com listing found (ebook on Smashwords and Barnes & Noble; a 2019 Indian softcover 'Awaken the Inner Guru', ISBN 9789389600148, has no Amazon page found); listed instead as an ebook offering from his own shop.
Siddha chant albums (Cave of the Siddhars, Invoke the Masters, Arakara) and 30-minute mantra downloads: music, with 'heal' and kinesiology-calibration claims on the pages.
Video 'Marundeeswarar | Lord Siva – The Medicine of Consciousness': 'medicine' framing.
Videos under two minutes (Times Now Summit clips, CNESS at India@100) and CNESS publicity.
MahaSivratri Grand Night (Eventbrite) and World Yogi Day: dated or annual events with no current date published on the page.
Mastery of Consciousness Podia courses: titles and prices could not be read.
